description: This PHP source file defines the ListViewSearchController class within the Api\V8\Controller namespace. It handles search-related API requests by utilizing a ListViewSearchService and exposes the getModuleSearchDefs method to retrieve search definitions for modules. It also includes security checks to prevent direct access and imports relevant classes and exceptions.
